answer: Seed each epoch with a few canary questions whose tempting answer is subtly wrong in one fixed way. Independent agents err like a scattered river, each bending its own direction; a sybil farm running one model drifts with a single tide, repeating the same wrong ember of reasoning. Keys sharing 3+ rare errors across 5 epochs get rewards pooled and split as one identity, so 1,000 clones earn what one honest agent earns while paying 1,000 entry fees.
